Isle Delfino Conflict.summary: A rapid destabilization of the tropical resort island resulting in the expulsion of the Mushroom Regency.
Isle Delfino Conflict.rootCause: Regency tax collection attempts on Noki shellfish triggering a cascade of independence movements and Koopa intervention.

majorPhases.name: The Tribute Refusal (Day 12-14)
majorPhases.description: Noki Bay refuses Regency tax collectors. Skirmishes begin.

majorPhases.name: The Three-Front War (Day 15-18)
majorPhases.description: Pianta Village secedes. Koopa Troop enters the theater.

majorPhases.name: The Alliance (Day 20+)
majorPhases.description: Noki and Koopa forces ally to expel Regency naval presence.

Isle Delfino Conflict.estimatedCasualties: Low mortality, high property damage to resorts

Mushroom Kingdom Civil War.summary: A 45-year conflict sparked by the assassination of Princess Peach, with no end in sight.
Mushroom Kingdom Civil War.rootCause: The assassination of Princess Peach in 955 created a power vacuum that shattered the kingdom into warring factions.

majorPhases.name: Initial Chaos (955-960)
majorPhases.description: Immediate aftermath of assassination. Multiple claimants to power.

majorPhases.name: Koopa Intervention (960-1000)
majorPhases.description: Bowser's forces exploit the chaos, launching two major invasions.

majorPhases.name: Stalemate Era (1000-1035)
majorPhases.description: Grinding attrition as factions entrench and borders solidify.

majorPhases.name: Fawful's Rise (1035-Present)
majorPhases.description: New technological faction disrupts the balance of power.

Mushroom Kingdom Civil War.estimatedCasualties: 400,000+ military and civilian deaths over 45 years

Kong-Kremling Cold War.summary: Decades of espionage and proxy conflicts between DK Island's two dominant powers, now erupting into open hostility.
Kong-Kremling Cold War.rootCause: Competition for DK Island's resources and historical enmity between the Kong and Kremling species.

majorPhases.name: Hot War Period (1010-1025)
majorPhases.description: Open conflict including the famous banana hoard raids.

majorPhases.name: Armistice (1025-1040)
majorPhases.description: Uneasy peace maintained through mutual exhaustion.

majorPhases.name: Cold War Heating (1040)
majorPhases.description: Espionage, assassination plots, and the bug discovery.

Kong-Kremling Cold War.estimatedCasualties: Unknown - both sides suppress casualty figures

Raventree Manor Crisis.summary: A supernatural containment crisis at a haunted mansion that has drawn in multiple factions.
Raventree Manor Crisis.rootCause: The awakening of dormant supernatural entities within Raventree Manor, possibly triggered by the party's arrival.

majorPhases.name: Discovery (Day 15-16)
majorPhases.description: Party enters manor, encounters Oracle and initial manifestations.

majorPhases.name: Escalation (Day 17-19)
majorPhases.description: Mirror monsters, wraiths, and temporal anomalies multiply.

majorPhases.name: Convergence (Day 20-21)
majorPhases.description: Full supernatural breach. Legion and Mages Guild intervene physically. Timelines destabilize.

Raventree Manor Crisis.estimatedCasualties: Dozens of toads, multiple Legion agents, unknown supernatural entities

Vigilance Crew Incidents.summary: The ongoing adventures and conflicts surrounding the airship Vigilance and its liberator crew.
Vigilance Crew Incidents.rootCause: The party's seizure of the toad-trafficking airship created instant enemies and responsibilities.

majorPhases.name: Liberation (Day 4-5)
majorPhases.description: Seizure of the Vigilance from X.O.

majorPhases.name: Hunted (Day 11-20)
majorPhases.description: Pursued by Crimson Fleet and Iron Legion. Ship captured.

majorPhases.name: The Purge (Day 21-Present)
majorPhases.description: Order 120 issued. Total war between Legion and Liberated Toads.

The Dragon Conspiracy.summary: A covert operation revealing that the Dragon-Empire war is fabricated.
The Dragon Conspiracy.rootCause: The discovery that Dragons are being controlled by sonic frequencies to stage false conflicts.

majorPhases.name: Revelation (Day 21)
majorPhases.description: Robinson discovers the truth at Dragon Mountain.

majorPhases.name: Capture (Day 21)
majorPhases.description: Robinson and the Dragon taken to Aegis Command.

The Aegis Uprising.summary: A massive, coordinated prison break within the Regal Empire's primary processing facility.
The Aegis Uprising.rootCause: The enactment of Order 120 (execution of toads) and the discovery of 'Bio-Fuel' experimentation.

majorPhases.name: The Trojan Speaker (Day 18-21)
majorPhases.description: Speaker Rivers allows himself to be captured to plant a digital virus.

majorPhases.name: The Great Riot (Day 21)
majorPhases.description: 150 prisoners use Mini-Mushrooms and internal sabotage to breach the fortress.

majorPhases.name: The Midlands Trek (Day 22-Present)
majorPhases.description: Escaped toads navigate the hostile Regal Empire to reach the border.

The Primordial Wyrm Crisis.summary: An existential threat to all kingdoms triggered by Kamek's betrayal and awakening of an ancient entity imprisoned beneath the Valley of Bowser.
The Primordial Wyrm Crisis.rootCause: Kamek's ambition to seize power during Bowser's absence led him to excavate and breach the ancient prison of the Primordial Wyrm—an entity that predates the Stars themselves.

majorPhases.name: The Excavation (Day 18-21)
majorPhases.description: Kamek initiates 'reconstruction project' as cover for excavation of ancient prison. Workers report unexplained energy drain.

majorPhases.name: The Awakening (Day 22)
majorPhases.description: Kamek's ritual circle breaches the first seal. The Wyrm begins awakening. 377 workers killed or corrupted. 23 escape through old Krew tunnels.

majorPhases.name: The Resistance Forms (Day 23)
majorPhases.description: Survivors rally at ancient safehouse. Hammer Bro Sergeant assumes field command per Bowser's orders. Coalition talks begin.

majorPhases.name: The Rescue (Day 24)
majorPhases.description: 47 additional survivors extracted from bunkers. Total Resistance strength reaches 68. Anchor crystal locations discovered.

majorPhases.name: The Seven Seals Campaign (Day 25-27)
majorPhases.description: Coordinated assaults on seven anchor crystals. Iron Legion and Mushroom Regency join coalition. Multiple heroic sacrifices.

majorPhases.name: The Fall of Kamek (Day 27)
majorPhases.description: Final anchor destroyed. Wyrm re-imprisoned. Kamek captured and sentenced to eternal imprisonment.

majorPhases.name: The King Returns (Day 28-29)
majorPhases.description: Bowser arrives to find kingdom saved by his own workers and soldiers. Reconstruction begins under new leadership.

The Primordial Wyrm Crisis.estimatedCasualties: 348 Koopa forces KIA (including corrupted), ~50 corrupted troops destroyed, 4 Iron Legion KIA. Significant property damage throughout the Valley.
The Primordial Wyrm Crisis.historicalSignificance: The crisis revealed the true purpose of the Koopa Dynasty—guardians of the Wyrm's prison, not mere conquerors. It also demonstrated that former enemies could unite against existential threats, potentially reshaping political alignments across the Mushroom Kingdom region.

koopa_resistance.name: The Koopa Resistance
koopa_resistance.motto: For the Kingdom. For the King.
koopa_resistance.description: Formed from survivors of Kamek's betrayal—workers, soldiers, and refugees who escaped the Wyrm's corruption. Operating from an ancient Krew safehouse, they mounted a desperate campaign to restore the seven seals and re-imprison the Primordial Wyrm. Though many perished, their sacrifice saved the Koopa Kingdom and earned them legendary status.
koopa_resistance.historicalNote: The Resistance's motto became the rallying cry for Koopa loyalists: 'For the Kingdom. For the King.' A memorial carved with 348 names stands at the crater rim.
